correctness.rationale: For each allowed polynomial the Cox normalization gives the exact four-divisor complement. The excluded smooth connected graph in B×C* is principal even with repeated roots. Integral Gysin yields free H¹=Z⁴ and H²=Z^(q+4); a logarithmic meridian and residue/cup-product compatibility reduce the decomposable quotient to Z^q/(m_i), with the announced Smith normal form. The fixed-F_a examples meet endpoint and nonnegative coefficient hypotheses and have exactly one root of multiplicity m. Standalone exact polynomial and Smith checks were executed; they are supplementary to this proof.

value.rationale: The very affine loci of a full natural class of positive Cox charts on Picard-rank-two toric surfaces have a multiplicity-sensitive integral ring invariant, despite torsion-free cohomology groups and constant Betti numbers across the distinguishing family. It explicitly separates at least a isomorphism types on one F_a and makes an unbounded family of cyclic quotient orders visible, giving information not recoverable from established Euler/ML-degree formulas.
